text: よいが　さめるまで　まつしかないわ

structure.jp: よいが　さめるまで

patterns.name: 〜しかない
patterns.explanation: しかない after a verb says there is no choice except that one thing. まつしかない = 'have no choice but to wait'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.explanation: まで after a verb means up to the time that thing happens. さめるまで = 'until it wears off'.
